stops.name: Western Pomerania Lagoon Area National Park
stops.quote: The third largest national park in Germany is the Baltic Sea National Park, covering 786 km².
stops.english: The third largest national park in Germany is the Baltic Sea National Park, covering 786 km².

stops.name: West beach
stops.quote: The 14 km long western beach in the National Park is wild and constantly changing.
stops.english: The 14 km long western beach in the National Park is wild and constantly changing.

stops.name: Lighthouse Darßer Ort
stops.quote: The lighthouse Darßer Ort is the only active lighthouse in the region and has been in operation since 1849.
stops.english: The lighthouse Darßer Ort is the only active lighthouse in the region and has been in operation since 1849.

stops.name: Prerower See Bridge
stops.quote: At 720 metres, the Prerower See Bridge is the longest on the Baltic coast.
stops.english: At 720 metres, the Prerower See Bridge is the longest on the Baltic coast.

stops.name: island harbor
stops.quote: At the end is the newly horseshoe-shaped island harbor.
stops.english: At the end is the newly horseshoe-shaped island harbor.

stops.name: Baltic Sea Cycle Route
stops.quote: On the Baltic Sea Cycle Route you pass wide beaches, native forests and quiet lagoon-landscapes.
stops.english: On the Baltic Sea Cycle Route you pass wide beaches, native forests and quiet lagoon-landscapes.

stops.name: Ahrenshoop
stops.quote: Explore Ahrenshoop as a place of art, walk in the footsteps of former artists and experience numerous galleries, studios and exhibitions.
stops.english: Explore Ahrenshoop as a place of art, walk in the footsteps of former artists and experience numerous galleries, studios and exhibitions.
